plan: Given my value of $30, I aim to win while ensuring a profit. Bidding too high risks overpaying, while bidding too low risks losing. Assuming others bid near their values, I'll bid slightly above average, around $25, to outbid lower bids and still profit if I win. The third-highest bid is likely close to the lowest bid, minimizing my cost.

Given my value of $7, my goal is to maximize profit by winning only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower than my value. Assuming others bid close to their values, I should bid slightly higher than half my value to avoid overpaying. A bid of $3.5 balances the chance of winning with minimizing overpayment.

My value is $36. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure winning while minimizing costs. Assuming Andy and Betty bid based on their values, I should bid around $35 to outbid them if their values are close but below mine. This way, if I win, I pay the third-highest bid, ideally lower than my bid, maximizing my profit.
